The execution failed due to a missing 'justification' key in the output JSON and a formatting mismatch in the summary text.
The test_totals_and_decision failed with a KeyError: 'justification' when accessing data['analysis']['recommendation']['justification']. Additionally, test_summary_requirements failed an assertion because the formatted value '-7,106.39' (with comma) was not found in the summary text which contained '-7106.39'. The subprocess running pytest on /tests/test_outputs.py returned code 1, resulting in a verifier reward of 0.00.
